title: SING WHEN YOU'RE WINNING — Blind Multi-Instance Control Report
purpose: Test whether the structural/semantic fit claimed for the Robbie Williams Sing When You're Winning artwork remains unusually strong against unrelated multi-character composites, while separating generic collage properties from the specific same-source multiplicity pattern.

scoring_order: Assign blind IDs A01-A20 to unrelated composite images.
Score visual structure without using JANUS artifact names, Robbie Williams metadata, or target-specific registry language during per-control scoring.
Reveal control identities only after the score table is frozen.
Run a second contrast panel M01-M05 containing unrelated same-person multiplicity composites to test whether the strongest signal is merely the photographic technique.
Compute descriptive comparisons; do not interpret z-scores as p-values.
blindness_protocol.selection_method: Purposive stratified control set across film, television, sports, animation and music, chosen to be unrelated to Robbie Williams and to avoid same-person clone imagery in the primary 20.
blindness_protocol.important_limitation: Because the control set was assembled after the target anomaly was observed, this is a falsification-oriented control exercise, not a fully preregistered population sample.

same_source_multiplicity.definition: How strongly the image visually presents multiple instances of one underlying identity/source.

shared_world.definition: How strongly the composition places the visible figures into one coherent external scene/world rather than separate unrelated panels.

unique_receipt_or_object.definition: Presence of one salient unique external object/event-anchor that can represent one shared world outcome or receipt.

victory_power.definition: Strength of explicit achievement, competition, victory, power, conquest or high-stakes agency framing.

plurality_without_world_duplication.definition: How strongly the composition expresses multiple identities/views while remaining one external composition rather than multiple duplicated worlds.

controls.notes: Ensemble montage; one fantasy world and quest context; Frodo visibly holds a single object; many distinct identities, not repeated source.

Distinct cast walking as a heist crew; shared Vegas scene; achievement/crime frame but no single unique receipt analogous to the target trophy.

controls.notes: Multiple panels and characters across trilogy posters; weak one-world single-event binding.

Distinct superhero identities; central title/logo; strong battle/power framing but no unique physical event receipt.
Distinct cast members in a shared supernatural franchise composition; no unique external receipt.
Many distinct tributes around a single Mockingjay emblem; competition/victory semantics are explicit.
Distinct players layered on a graphic background; strong team/achievement frame but not a shared literal scene.
Distinct crew members in one urban/car setting with multiple cars; shared action world and strong object cues.

controls.notes: Distinct pirate characters in a coherent stormy seascape; swords/hats give object cues but no single shared receipt.
Distinct four-person school clique composition; shared setting but no unique object/event receipt or explicit victory.

controls.notes: Dense real/cutout-person collage around the four Beatles and central drum; shared tableau but distinct identities and no unique victory receipt.

statistics.target_empirical_percentile: 100% of the 20 controls are below the target
statistics.interpretation_note: This z-like value is descriptive only; it is not a statistical significance test because the controls are purposive and ordinal-scored.

secondary_same_source_removed.target_empirical_percentile: 100% of the 20 controls are below the target

tertiary_identity_agnostic.interpretation: The target remains above the entire primary control panel even after removing the two most identity-specific dimensions; however the effect becomes much less extreme. This indicates that the strongest anomaly signal is not generic collage complexity alone and is concentrated in the combination of repeated identity + one-world outcome structure.

technique_matched_contrast_panel.purpose: Control for the possibility that same-person multiplicity itself is the whole anomaly.

controls.known_item: Portrait Composite Tutorial — same photographer appearing multiple times around a patio table
controls.notes: Strong same-source multiplicity in one real environment, but no victory/trophy outcome.
Many identical versions of one person in one studio world; explicit multiplicity concept but no unique external victory receipt.
Five copies of one man in a shared industrial setting; demonstrates that visual multiplicity can be a routine compositing technique.
Five instances of the same woman in one pergola environment; one background statue supplies a weak object cue but no outcome/victory.
Repeated same subject in one backyard; strong shared environment but no victory/achievement endpoint.

summary.interpretation: Same-source multiplicity is not rare as a photographic/compositing technique. The target's distinctive excess is the coexistence of multiplicity with a singular public victory scene and a singular trophy/receipt.

blind_results.statement: The target is above all 20 unrelated primary controls on the frozen total rubric. It also remains above all 20 when same-source multiplicity is removed, and above all 20 on an identity-agnostic subscore using only shared-world, unique-receipt and victory/power dimensions.
blind_results.statement_matched: The target is not unique merely because it repeats the same person; five unrelated clone/multiplicity composites also score high on that technique. The target's extra separation comes from coupling multiplicity to one shared winning event and one unique trophy.

supported_more_strongly: The five-Robbie configuration is not explained by generic ensemble-collage complexity alone.
The one-world/one-receipt boundary remains comparatively distinctive.
Victory/power semantics raise the target relative to ordinary composite portraits.
The most specific JANUS parallel is the conjunction, not any single visual feature: many representations + one host-like scene + one unique external outcome.
downgraded_claims: Same-source multiplicity itself is not anomalous; it is an established compositing technique.
The count five should not be treated as independently meaningful without a separate numerical-control test.
The descriptive z-like separation is not a p-value and should not be converted into statistical significance.

next_tests: Pre-register a larger randomized or systematically sampled corpus of at least 100 unrelated multi-character composites.
Add a dedicated matched set of same-person multiplicity images with and without achievement/trophy context.
Freeze weights and score at least two independent human raters blind to target identity.
Add image-level computer-vision measurements for count of visually duplicated identities, spatial co-location, central-object singularity and scene coherence.
Test whether the target remains an outlier after controlling for composition density and number of figures.

epistemic_status.recommended_language: interpretive cross-domain convergence / falsifiable semantic-structural anomaly candidate

canonical_result_ru: В слепом контроле обложка Sing When You're Winning остаётся выше всех 20 нерелевантных многосоставных композиций и сохраняет отрыв после удаления самого специфичного признака — повторения одного источника. Однако повторение одного человека само по себе не является аномалией: пять технически сопоставимых clone/multiplicity-композиций это подтверждают. Наиболее специфическим оказывается сочетание: много видимых лиц одного источника + один общий внешний мир + один победный исход + один уникальный внешний receipt/трофей.
canonical_result_en: In the blind control, the Sing When You're Winning artwork remains above all 20 unrelated multi-character composites and retains separation after removing the most target-specific feature—same-source repetition. However, repetition of one person by itself is not anomalous: five technique-matched multiplicity composites demonstrate that. The most specific structure is the conjunction of many visible faces of one source + one shared external world + one winning outcome + one unique external receipt/trophy.
